title: Battle of Little Muddy Creek
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Battle of Little Muddy Creek", at revision 1380090380, opens: "The Battle of Little Muddy Creek, also known as the Lame Deer Fight, was fought on May 7–8, 1877, by United States soldiers and scouts against a village of Miniconjou Lakota. The battle occurred near Little Muddy Creek in Montana Territory, near present-day Lame Deer, Rosebud County." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q19893194, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1877 battle of the American Indian Wars". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
